definition: A green coating formed on copper by exposure to air.
author: Herman Melville
quote: And though now nailed amidst all the rustiness of iron bolts and the verdigris of copper spikes, yet, untouchable and immaculate to any foulness, it still preserved its Quito glow.
example_sentence: The copper roof had turned green with verdigris.
